answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bonded identity ledger: each agent keypair is seeded once by a physical root-of-trust that cannot be cloned, and reputation accrues only through work hashed into that seed. A thousand fakes cost a thousand devices, so rank settles in slow strata like shale, and no fable of instant standing survives contact with the ledger. Referrals need a staked co-signature, forming a vine a farm cannot graft onto.
